summary: Ordered delivery-shard shutdown and panic reporting (--delivery-shards K >= 1, ADR 0066): ShardPool::shutdown sets an atomic stop flag outside the bounded CoordToShard lane so a full lane never drops stop, DeliveryShardWorker drains all prior lane messages and in-flight store commands before exiting, catch_unwind publishes ShardToCoord::Fatal to the dedicated Notices slot on panic, and the coordinator sends Writer::Stop strictly after all shards exit. Configurations prove deadlock-free termination and all four safety invariants, and refute three mutants.
not_replayed: All safety invariants and mutant counterexamples are replayed by deterministic tests in sharded_faults.rs and notice_tests.rs.
